title: Settings - Translation Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the Settings data model. It belongs to the Translation Module.

types.name: entity_type
types.description: The entity type that these settings apply to (e.g., "product", "product\_variant").

types.name: fields
types.description:
The translatable fields for this entity type.
Array of field names that can be translated.

types.name: is_active
types.description: Wether the entity translatable status is enabled.
